findings.description: Every disagreement between the two contracts. Empty when they agree.

key.description: The prop name, axis name, state name, or Figma variable name the disagreement is about.

renamedTo.description: OPTIONAL. When this disagreement is a RENAME, the name the other side uses. Set `key` to the name one side uses, `kind` to "value-mismatch", and this to the other. The underlying differ has no rename concept and records a rename as two findings (the old name missing from one side, the new name missing from the other); reporting it as one finding WITH this field set is scored as covering both halves, so the better analysis is not penalised.

winner.description: Which side should be treated as correct when reconciling this one disagreement.

verdict.description: in-sync only when findings is empty.

sourceUsed.description: Files, tools or documents actually consulted.
